description:
You are logged into wger fitness manager at http://localhost as admin (username: admin, password: adminadmin). You are a registered dietitian conducting a quarterly clinical audit of patient nutrition plans.

A clinical audit report has been placed at /home/ga/Documents/nutrition_audit_report.txt. This report identifies caloric goal errors in existing nutrition plans and specifies corrective actions.

Read the audit report and complete ALL corrective actions specified in it:
1. Correct the energy (kcal) goals for the three existing nutrition plans identified in the report
2. Create the two new measurement tracking categories specified in the report
3. Create the new corrective nutrition plan described in the report

All values must match the audit report exactly. Use the hamburger menu (three horizontal lines icon) on each nutrition plan page to access the Edit function for changing energy goals.
